description.value:
The palicos are small, bipedal felines renowned for their unwavering loyalty, boundless curiosity, and surprising aptitude for adventure.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Palicos gain +4 Dexterity, -2 Strength and -2 Wisdom.
  • Type: Palicos are Humanoid creatures with the feline subtype.
  • Size: Palicos are Small creatures.
  • Base Speed: Palicos have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Palicos begin play speaking Common and either Mithran or Ronsaur. Palicos with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Abyssal, Celestial, Elvaan, Galkan, Goblin, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Heavy Lifter: Palicos are treated as if their Strength score was 4 points higher for encumbrance.
  • Nimble Faller: Palicos land on their feet even after falling, gaining a +1 bonus to CMD against trip.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Feline Conversationalist: Palicos comprehend and communicate with feline animals.
  • Nimble: Palicos use Dexterity to modify Climb and Swim checks.

Movement Racial Traits

  • Sprinter: Palicos gain a 10-foot racial bonus to speed when charging, running, or withdrawing.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Bite: Palicos have a bite attack dealing 1d3 damage.
  • Claws: Palicos have two claw attacks dealing 1d3 damage each.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Cat Senses: Palicos have low-light vision and the scent ability.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Non-threatening: Palicos suffer a -4 penalty on Intimidation checks.
  • Easily Distracted: Palicos suffer a -2 penalty on Concentration checks.
  • Naïve: Palicos suffer a -2 penalty on Sense Motive checks.
